lens: Skeptic: every detail is treated as wrong until a real photo shows it right. Official ANA photos y_47300-07 set colours and finishes; SANspotter NH7 2023 (sans_*) and fr57325_* set geometry and unshown details. Measurements use PIL/numpy (Otsu light fraction, L50, p90/p50, light/dark means, column and row profile CV, blob statistics) on matched regions. Scripts and crops are in /tmp/claude-0/raterA10/.

priorIssues.issue: w9a-1 Headrest covers too dark and grey; they merge with the backs (q16)
priorIssues.status: fixed in q16; overshoots in q15
priorIssues.evidence: q16: cover2 L50 85 and cover3 92 (r9 57), against y_47301 68-104. Cover/back 1.33 against photo 0.83-1.5. q15 head-on: covers L50 60/104/108/60 against y_47300 64/47/37/35, so cover/back is now 1.6-2.9 (r9 about 1.0) against photo 0.5-0.75. The satin r 0.38 on yCover #535b7c picks up the bright ceiling in the head-on view, where the real leatherette reads darker than the fabric.

priorIssues.issue: w9a-2 / w9b-2 Dash mosaic clumps on a diagonal checker
priorIssues.status: partially fixed (diagonal clumps gone; it now reads as a vertical barcode)
priorIssues.evidence: The tile is axis-aligned now, and the chevrons and leopard spots are gone. But q15 seat 2 has light area 0.41 against y_47306 right 0.31, and every dash is the same length, the same grey and very regular. In the 2x crop (q15z.png) the cells line up as vertical streak columns. The photo (p06_right.png) shows fine heather dashes, modulated in horizontal rectangular blocks of different widths, with no strong vertical columns.

priorIssues.issue: w9a-3 / w9b-1 Diamond overcorrected: low-contrast fuzzy blobs that swamp the ground
priorIssues.status: fixed on area and contrast; new figure/lattice mismatch
priorIssues.evidence: Light area: q15 0.21, q16 0.20, e4b 0.28 (r9 0.35-0.47), against y_47306 left 0.20. p90/p50 in e4b is 1.96 (r9 1.44) against 1.69; L light/dark is 2.07 against 1.97. The figures, though, are crisp stepped diamonds filled with horizontal 2 px stripes. They are isolated, about 4.5-5.5 cm, with about 35 % of the sites empty, so they read as scattered polka-diamonds (q15 seat 1, q16 row 2, e4 and e4b). In p06_dia.png the figures are about 6-7 cm, soft and mottled. They touch corner to corner in a regular diagonal argyle lattice with no empty sites.

issues.title: Tick weave is still a knitted V-stitch rain; no column structure (carried over from w9b-3)
issues.evidence: Column-profile CV q15 seat 3 0.066 against y_47300 seat 3 0.197; col/row ratio 1.19 against 5.09 (seat 1: 3.66). The photo is vertical columns of short light bars (about 6-10 mm long, about 2 mm wide) at a period of about 14 mm, separated by clean navy channels. The tile has chevron stitches with no channels. On the pans (e1, e7) it reads as sweater knit.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py: replace the y_tick photo crop with a synthesised tile, as was done for y_mosaic. Make 0.2 m = 14 columns (about 18 px period at 256 px). In each column, use 2-3 px wide vertical bars, 7-12 px long, with jittered gaps of 2-5 px, and give each column a random phase. Keep the 5-6 px channels between columns at ground level, plus a faint weave noise. Use lift about (3.2, 3.2, 2.7). Target: tile light area about 0.35-0.45, column CV at least 0.15. Leave SEATMAT yFabric as is.

issues.title: Diamond figures are isolated, crisp, stripe-filled polka-diamonds; the photo is a continuous soft argyle lattice
issues.evidence: The area is right now (q15 0.21, q16 0.20, e4b 0.28 against 0.20). But about 35 % of the sites are empty and the figures are 4.5-5.5 cm with hard edges and visible 2 px horizontal stripe fill (e4, e4b). In p06_dia.png the figures are about 6-7 cm and soft-edged, with mottled interiors (light #a6bbe8 over #465da1). They touch at the corners in a regular diagonal lattice with no gaps. In q16 the figures clip to near-white #d4d7dd with L light/dark 3.98 against the photo 1.97; the studio gives 2.07, so in-cabin exposure adds to this.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_diamond: fill every lattice site (drop the 35 % empty sites). Use a 4 x 4 diamond lattice per 0.2 m tile, about 50 mm pitch, so the figures (about 46 mm, corner to corner) almost touch diagonally. Replace the 2 px dash-run fill with a mottle: the figure mask times (0.6 + 0.4 x value noise at about 3 mm), then a 1 px blur. Keep the serrated edge as a jitter of ±2 px on the stepped outline. Reduce the lift to about (3.0, 2.9, 2.4) so the in-cabin q16 figures stay below clipping, and recheck that light area stays at 0.20-0.25.

issues.title: Head-on (q15), the satin covers are 1.6-2.9x as bright as the backs; in y_47300 they are darker than the fabric
issues.evidence: q15 covers L50 60/104/108/60 against y_47300 64/47/37/35. Cover/back is 1.6-2.9 against 0.5-0.75 (r9 about 1.0). In q16 the covers are now right (85-92 against 68-104). The real leatherette is satin but brightens only at grazing, overhead angles (y_47301, y_47303).
issues.fix: 09_seats.js SEATMAT yCover: raise the roughness 0.38 -> 0.5 and set the base to about #4c5474. In 09a_econ.js, also tilt the cover flap's lower part about 4-6 deg forward (the photo flap bows out from the pad) so the head-on view does not mirror the ceiling cove. Recheck q15 cover/back at 0.7-1.2 and q16 at 1.0-1.4.

issues.title: Dash mosaic reads as vertical barcode columns, not a heathered block mosaic
issues.evidence: q15 seat 2 light area 0.41 against y_47306 right 0.31. All dashes are the same length (about 6-11 mm) and the same flat grey (lift 7, 7, 6), in strict columns, so q15z.png shows vertical stripes. In p06_right.png the dashes are finer (1 px at 1.7 mm/px, varied lengths) and slightly blue-tinted (light #7282b1 over #223262). The modulation is in horizontal rectangular blocks of different widths and heights, with no column read.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_mosaic: vary the cell widths (12-30 mm) and heights (15-25 mm) with row-wise brick offsets instead of column offsets. Vary dash length 3-12 px and brightness ±25 % per dash. Use a lift of about (5.0, 5.4, 5.6) for a bluish white, and cut the dense fill 48 % -> 38 % and the sparse fill 22 % -> 15 % so tile light area is about 0.28-0.32.

issues.title: Seat fabrics are about 40 % darker in q15 than in r9, with no change to the fabric materials (cross-area: lighting)
issues.evidence: q15 L50 by seat, r9 -> r10: 64->33, 57->37, 67->37, 44->27, against y_47300 93/52/69/47. The fleck seat (yFabricD and tex_y_fleck both unchanged) dropped 44->27, and the yFabric change #5a6587->#55607f is only about 7 %. The ceiling band changed only 189->186. The drop lines up with lighting snapshots 282136c / 9f2d20e (04_shaders.js, 12_scene.js), committed between the r9 and r10 renders.
issues.fix: Lighting owner: check the new seat-level AO/shadow term in the 04_shaders.js / 12_scene.js snapshot against q15 (back fabric L50 should be about 0.8-1.0x y_47300). Econ should NOT lighten SEATMAT to compensate until the lighting snapshot is final.

issues.title: Fleck blobs are round and dense; the photo flecks are sparser, elongated petals
issues.evidence: Tile blobs: median 5.5 x 4.7 mm, aspect 1.22, 76/dm2. y_47306 middle pad: 6.8 x 5.1 mm, aspect 1.45 (resolution-limited; visually thin slivers about 3:1), about 50/dm2. Near pads in q16 read as snow/leopard blotches.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck: draw ellipses of 6-9 x 2-3 mm at random angles ±40 deg around vertical. Cut the count about 30 % (to about 50/dm2) and keep lift (7.5, 6.8, 4.0).

issues.title: Armrests are straight boxes on a vertical post
issues.evidence: In y_47300 and y_47303 the armrest is slender and slopes down toward the front, with a rounded tip. At the front it curves down in a J into the seat-frame spreader, and there is a light-grey pad on top. In e7 and e1 the armrest is a horizontal rounded box on a vertical post set back from the front.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econUnit armrest: loft the arm along a 3-point spline (rear pivot -> top 0.60 m -> front 0.56 m), tapering 55 -> 40 mm wide. Replace the vertical post with a curved support from about 70 % of the arm length down to the spreader, using the same SEC/loftAt helpers.

issues.title: Small seatback and cover details
issues.evidence: The tray face carries a 3-socket item with red marks (q18, e5). In sans 15 / 20 the tray face has only a pale placard with grey seat pictograms, a 'Stow and latch handset' label strip and the latch; the outlet is the black box by the pocket, which is already modelled. The handset is 0.41 of the bezel width against 0.47-0.48. The pocket flap is white against grey leatherette (sans 20). The cover has no debossed ANA bird mark at the lower right (y_47306, all three seats). The pillow is too smooth (p90/p50 1.08 against 1.3-1.5; no piping).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: recolour the tray-face item to a #d8d8d4 placard with #8a8a8a pictograms and no red. Add a 0.25 x 0.012 m label strip at the tray's bottom edge. Widen the handset about 15 %. Set the pocket flap to about #b9bbbf. Add a small darker atlas decal at the lower right of each cover. Add piping tubes on the pillow's edge seams and give it the fabric layer at strength 0.6.

questionsForUser: Do you have a photo of the economy seats taken straight on in normal cabin lighting? ANA's studio shot (y_47300) shows the headrest covers darker than the fabric, but the in-flight angles show them light grey. A neutral frontal photo would settle what the covers should look like head-on.

Is there a high-resolution close-up of the diamond-lattice and dash-mosaic fabrics, for example from a Recaro or ANA press kit or a trip report? At the official 930 px size, the scale and edges of the figures are only measured to about ±1 cm.
